# Sushant Kumar

> Cyber Security Engineer, Digital Forensics Researcher, AI Systems Developer, and Founder of TechDenLab. Specializing in IoT security, edge artificial intelligence, automated digital forensics, intrusion detection architectures, and secure cloud infrastructure.

Sushant Kumar is an engineering researcher and systems builder based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. He combines low-level embedded hardware and network forensics with modern LLM orchestration and edge AI to construct high-reliability security architectures.

## Core Affiliations & Education
- **Founder**: TechDenLab (https://techdenlab.com) - Engineering research and technology laboratory specializing in cybersecurity, AI systems development, cloud infrastructure, and intelligent embedded hardware.
- **Education**: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security & Digital Forensics) at MIT World Peace University (MIT-WPU), Pune, India.
  - Academic Performance: CGPA 9.16 / 10.0 (Class 10: 94.6%, Class 12: 94.6%).
- **Industry Role**: Cloud Solutions Architect Engineer at Technophiles Den.

## Verified Innovations & Peer-Reviewed Publications
- [Omniscient: Digital Forensics & Cybercrime Investigation Platform](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/sushant-kumar-csf_patent-cybersecurity-digitalforensics-share-7431899800880635905-P-lY/): Patented automated evidence extraction, artifact timeline sequencing, and anti-forensic triage platform.
  - **Patent Status**: Published Indian Patent Application (ID: 202521077464, Indian Patent Office InPASS).
  - **Invention Title**: "A System and Method for Dynamic Cybercrime Investigation Using Automated Data Extraction and Analysis".
- [VACARS: Voice Assisted Context Aware Response System](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/sushant-kumar-csf_springernature-journalpublication-researchpublication-ugcPost-7503114970688253953-b1rO/): IoT and AI assisted smart helmet system for rider safety, edge accident detection, and context-aware speech processing.
  - **Publication**: Published in a Springer Nature journal.
  - **Key Tech**: Raspberry Pi, OpenCV MobileNet-SSD edge object detection, offline STT, low-latency motor-driven faceplate actuation (<350ms), DMA frame buffer offloading.
- [ICCUBEA 2026 Best IEEE Research Paper Award](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/sushant-kumar-csf_bestpaperaward-ieee-iccubea2026-activity-7496944806515044352-iP5O/): Awarded Best Paper in the Blockchain & Cyber Security Track at the 10th IEEE International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA 2026), PCCOE Pune.
  - **Paper Title**: "An Early-Exit Hybrid Intrusion Detection Architecture for Resource-Constrained Environments".

## Key Engineering Projects
- [RakshaNetra](https://github.com/rsk807/rakshak-pii): Proactive client-edge Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) system for LLM integrations. Sanitizes enterprise tokens, credentials, and PII in under 14ms prior to API transmission via browser service worker proxy hooks.
- [BidForge](https://github.com/rsk807/BidForge): Autonomous multi-agent Request for Proposal (RFP) parsing and bidding proposal generation pipeline. Built with Bun, TypeScript, LangChain, Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, and MongoDB vector semantic search.
- **Orbit Telemetry**: High-frequency aerospace sensor ingestion and telemetry monitoring system built for orbital tracking and real-time anomaly detection.
- **Cyber Bhairava**: Threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, and digital forensics incident response platform.
- **PS151**: Embedded hardware security and firmware evaluation testbed engineered for mission-critical physical computing systems.
- **EduGraph**: Interactive semantic knowledge graph platform designed for computer science curriculum mapping, prerequisite pathing, and conceptual mastery.
